end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten plus loose ones.
Saanvi identified 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18 using ten and extra ones.
They practised writing the tens digit first in 14 and 16.
They explained that one bundle contains ten sticks, not one.
The bundle-as-one counting mix-up remained in the final example.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers 11–20 from one bundle of ten and loose ones. They used counting on to find 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18, and explained that the bundle contains ten sticks. At the end, they still mixed up counting the bundle as one object with counting its ten sticks, so this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, show one group of 10 objects with 1–9 loose objects and ask, “How many altogether?” before writing the number.
